attachment_ids.description: Ids of files the user attached earlier in this chat (from a message's attachments) that belong on this job — at most 5; more is refused, ask the user which to keep. Omit if none apply. An id that no longer exists is silently dropped and reported back to you; tell the user if that happens.

budget.description: Optional budget for the job: a positive amount, at most 1000000000 with at most 12 decimal places. Omit unless the user stated a budget.

currency.description: Currency for the budget. REQUIRED when you set a budget; omit otherwise.

description.description: A clear brief of the work to be done (max 8192 chars). Longer briefs are rejected outright — split the detail across the job's attachments or trim it, do not truncate mid-sentence.

title.description: Short title for the job (max 200 chars).
